values.name: Modhera
values.description: Modhera stands near the Pushpavati River in north Gujarat. Its principal monument is the Solanki-era Sun Temple, with a sculpted assembly hall and stepped reservoir; the village also contains the Modheshwari Mata shrine.

records.notes: Destination facts paraphrased; site admission belongs to attraction, not entire village.

values.name: Modhera Sun Temple
values.entry_fee: INR20 Indian online admission; foreign online ticket INR250; booking conditions apply
values.description: The Sun Temple complex contains a carved shrine hall, an assembly hall and Surya Kund, a stepped reservoir lined with small shrines. It dates to the Solanki period.
values.best_time_note: Stored hours follow Gujarat Tourism's visitor brochure. Other sources describe sunrise to sunset. Two hours is a published visitor-duration recommendation, not a fixed tour. General wheelchair access remains unverified; entrance amenities do not establish access to stepped areas.
values.source: Gujarat Tourism; ASI ticketing listings; OpenStreetMap

records.notes: Current online fee preferred over conflicting historical brochures. Duration upper end of operator's 90-120 minute recommendation. Reservoir included, not duplicated as a separately charged visit.

values.name: Modheshwari Mata Temple
values.description: This Modhera shrine is dedicated to Modheshwari, a form of Parvati or Durga revered by the Modh community.
values.best_time_note: One hour is the lower end of a published 1-2 hour visit recommendation. Published daily opening hours conflict; confirm with temple before travel. Accessibility unknown.
values.source: Gujarat Tourism; Google Maps; local tour operator visitor guide

records.notes: Map anchor is the named Modheshwari Devi Mata Complex, archived pages/modhera-mata.json. Free admission/duration from operator guide; official tourism supports identity and description. Conflicting hours remain NULL.
